currentGoal: Fix the remaining weird grass tile visual artifacts shown in user screenshots, especially duplicate/old-position grass tiles after the play area grows or resizes.
workCompleted: Inspected the user screenshots and identified three visual artifact sources: stale batch-layer stamps underneath dirty live tile views, regrow feedback animating a squashed full grass tile texture, and other touch/automation feedback animating full grass-tile copies.
Added a generated tile-common-eraser texture and erased the stale common-layer footprint when a batch tile enters the dirty temporary-live-view path.
Replaced regrow feedback's full grass-tile image sprout with a lightweight ring plus star sparkle so it no longer resembles a duplicate mini tile.
Removed the remaining grassGhost/full grass-tile copies from normal touch feedback, first-touch feedback, and automation touch visuals; automation now uses a small star sparkle plus ring.

Changed Wild Spread tile feedback so newly added tiles always create/register tile views and run layoutTiles('field'), even while ambient feedback budgeting is active. This keeps cached field bounds and tile positions current before drop/sprout animations run.

After the user clarified the artifact happens when the play screen size increases, fixed the actual resize path: resize/ui/zoom/field layouts now reset position-bound board visuals, killing active tile-view tweens, clearing perfect-touch cues, pop text, and tracked board effects before redrawing at the new geometry.
Tracked automation touch ring/spark objects as board transients and moved active-object cleanup to destroy listeners, so resize cleanup can remove them without leaving the counter stale.
Verified desktop, phone, tablet, live-mode growth, width-growth resize, and height-only resize runs after the visual changes.
Captured resize repro screenshots around 835px width and live-mode small-field runs; the board no longer shows old-position duplicate tile copies after the play area grows.
